versions.changelog:
Initial release of Career Toolkit: an all-in-one career development toolchain.

- Integrates planning (Holland assessment, roadmap), resume building (multi-format export), and job application optimization (JD match, ATS check, bullet rewriting)
- Modular structure: career-planner, resume-builder, resume-optimizer, with automatic module routing based on user intent
- Supports seven themed resume renderings and PDF export
- Smooth data flow between modules, with field mapping between career profile and resume
- Command-line script guidance for all key features
